landmarks.name: Academic Quadrangle
facts: Its Brutalist courtyard has appeared as a location in many films and TV shows.
It was part of the original campus designed by Arthur Erickson and Geoffrey Massey, which opened in 1965.

landmarks.name: Lorne Davies Complex
facts: It holds the main gym and pool, named after the university's first athletic director.

landmarks.name: Shrum Science Centre - Chemistry
facts: It is part of a science complex named after the university's first chancellor.

landmarks.name: WAC Bennett Library
facts: It is the main library, named after a former Premier of British Columbia.
Its Brutalist building has been used as a filming location for movies and television.

landmarks.name: Student Union Building
facts: The student society finished building it, together with a new stadium, in August 2020.

landmarks.name: McTaggart-Cowan Hall
facts: It is a residence named after the university's first president.

landmarks.name: Marianne and Edward Gibson Art Museum
facts: It opened in September 2025 as a 12,000-square-foot arts and cultural facility.

landmarks.name: Halpern Centre
facts: Students call it the Grad Centre; it houses the graduate student society and a restaurant.
